section.controlled_paraphrase: After the table is closed, a foul for wrongly hitting the other group must be pronounced before the next shot. When any player or a referee realizes the groups have been wrongly played, the rack stops immediately and the balls are reracked.

uniquely_determined_rules: the clause applies after the table is closed rather than while groups remain open
wrongly hitting the other group is a foul
the foul-pronouncement deadline is before the next shot
a player or referee may be the party who realizes that groups were wrongly played
a valid group-confusion realization stops the rack immediately
the prescribed rack-level remedy is rerack
text_does_not_uniquely_determine: whether every ordinary wrong-first-ball foul is also a group-confusion rerack event
whether groups wrongly played means one wrong-group stroke, a mistaken group assignment, or a longer sequence of play under confused assignments
the authoritative evidence or declaration payload by which a player or referee realizes the confusion
whether discovery after the next shot has no remedy, a different remedy, or a referee remedy
whether next shot means cue-strike acceptance, completed stroke, or another boundary
whether the ordinary ball-in-hand foul entitlement is staged, suppressed, or superseded when a timely rerack declaration occurs
whether the original breaker and original shooting order are restored
the numbered rack seed or any non-official implementation completion beyond official rack geometry

row.assessment: No wrong-group discovery window, stop-rack action or corrective rerack transaction exists.

section_17_wrong_first_contact.fact: authoritative first-contact identity does not match the shooter's assigned group after groups are assigned
section_17_wrong_first_contact.current_effect: ordinary foul, opponent ball in hand and turn change

why_implementation_is_blocked.classification: The text does not uniquely say whether every wrong-first contact is group confusion or whether group confusion means play under a mistaken group assignment.
why_implementation_is_blocked.input: No player/referee realization request, actor authentication or evidence payload exists.
why_implementation_is_blocked.deadline: The runtime has no durable offending-shot identity and no Section 19 window that closes at the authoritative next-shot boundary.
why_implementation_is_blocked.effect_interaction: The text does not define how the ordinary ball-in-hand foul entitlement interacts with a timely stop-and-rerack declaration.
why_implementation_is_blocked.rerack: Section 19 does not state who breaks or which shooting order follows the rerack, while Core E requires an explicit breaker.

future_state_machine.window_open: Only after an authoritative completed shot under a closed-table assignment and only when future policy says its evidence can support Section 19.
future_state_machine.discovery_submit: Validate actor class and identity, referenced rack/shot/assignment, policy version, deadline, authority revision/state hash and idempotency before stopping play.
future_state_machine.next_shot_close: Close the window at the future policy-defined authoritative next-shot boundary; previews, aim changes and rejected Shoot requests never close it.
future_state_machine.rerack_commit: After policy supplies the breaker/order, prebuild one verified official rerack and atomically commit rack stop, rerack, reset, revision, event, action and receipt.

future_atomic_idempotency_contract.precommit: Validate ruleset, capability, flow, discovery/rack/shot identity, actor class and actor ID, exact action/payload, policy version, authority revision, state hash, deadline and idempotency before mutation.
future_atomic_idempotency_contract.stop_and_rerack: Rack stop may not become externally committed until the complete verified rerack plan and selected breaker/order are available for the same atomic parent transaction.
future_atomic_idempotency_contract.ordinary_foul_isolation: A failed, stale or conflicting Section 19 request leaves the independently adjudicated Section 17 foul and placement entitlement unchanged.
future_atomic_idempotency_contract.success_reset: One successful commit clears superseded foul placement, decision offers, shot collector, group assignment and Section 19 window, then starts one official rack under the approved breaker/order policy.
future_atomic_idempotency_contract.failure_rollback: Runtime, balls, rack, groups, player, entitlement, offers, discovery window, authority revision/hash, events, actions and receipts remain byte-equivalent to pre-call state.
future_atomic_idempotency_contract.exact_retry: Returns the original ACK without a second stop, rerack, reset, revision, event or action.

forbidden_scope: production source edits in this design-gap task
mapping every wrong-first-ball foul directly to a Section 19 rerack
guessing whether group confusion means one stroke or mistaken assignment play
inventing a player or referee discovery event from physics facts alone
guessing the next-shot deadline boundary or late-discovery remedy
guessing the rerack breaker or shooting order
exposing a group-confusion product seam or global Rules UI
